no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was requested for this application and no external consultations were required because the safety profile is acceptable for the treatment of patients with metastatic EGFR mutation-positive NSCLC, the application did not raise significant public health questions on the role of dacomitinib for this indication and outside expertise was not necessary since there were no controversial issues that would benefit from an advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the VIZIMPRO (dacomitinib) NDA 211288. The FDA Multi-Disciplinary Review (Section 11) states no AC meeting or external consultations were requested because the safety profile was acceptable, the application raised no significant public health questions, and there were no controversial issues warranting outside expertise. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
